summary: Confirmed via live re-fetch of dome wins.html (2026-07-19): dome WIN-010 has been re-anchored to the 2016-03-09 Pacific quiet-day eclipse (Kp<2, 5-station Z-tracking, GUA SNR 4.85), replacing the 2017 BOU Kp~3 anchor our review WIN-010 is built on. The 2017 BOU value persists only as WIN-012 coupling-constant numerator, and our WIN-012 already matches the live dome WIN-012 verbatim (no change needed there). Path (b) from the suggested_fix applies: our WIN-010 finding (Chapman Sq non-discriminating argument) is anchor-agnostic and still covers the underlying thesis, so no verdict change or full rewrite -- added a dated note to detail_evidence + detail_verdict_text documenting the re-anchoring and explaining why the critique still holds. Two find/replace patches on data/wins.json WIN-010 (fields detail_evidence, detail_verdict_text), both pre-simulated against the current file and confirmed to produce valid JSON at both raw-text and field level.
